annotations.title: Leased rents by bedroom, NSW postcodes

description:
Median weekly rent actually signed on new NSW tenancies, and the number of new bonds, each quarter since 2021 by dwelling type and bedrooms (flats, houses, townhouses), for every NSW postcode.

Coverage: NSW (and ACT-range postcodes lodged with NSW) postcodes with at least 5 new bonds in the quarter and group; March quarter 2021 onwards. Current to 2026-09-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/leased-rents-nsw`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: rent_all, rent_flat_1bed, rent_flat_2bed, rent_flat_3bed, rent_house_2bed, rent_house_3bed, rent_house_4bed, rent_townhouse_2bed, rent_townhouse_3bed, bonds_all, bonds_flat_1bed, bonds_flat_2bed, bonds_flat_3bed, bonds_house_2bed, bonds_house_3bed, bonds_house_4bed, bonds_townhouse_2bed, bonds_townhouse_3bed. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
